newsitem.title: USA: U.S. help-wanted ad index rose to 85 in November.
newsitem.headline: U.S. help-wanted ad index rose to 85 in November.

text.p: The U.S. help-wanted advertising index rose three points to 85.0 in November, the Conference Board said on Thursday.

In the last three months, the volume of help-wanted advertising increased in eight of the nine U.S. regions. The greatest increase was in New England, followed by the West North Central and Mountain regions.
The Conference Board said job advertising volume fell in only one region, the Middle Atlantic.
"The pace of job growth will not subside in the early months of 1997," Conference Board economist Ken Goldstein said in a statement.
"While there has been concern that the economy might soften and that layooffs would rise, latest job data show no let-up in the demand for labor across the (nation)," he said.
